title: Anticipatory Token Pattern Annotator & Tune Lens
creator: Ruth Chen
description: Design a lightweight, explainable UI component for the Redwood Console that surfaces 'anticipatory token patterns' (common prefix/utterance shapes) and suggests prefetch/batching profiles. The goal is to help operators and engineers quickly validate recommended caching/batching configs, understand trade-offs (latency vs cost vs correctness), and apply safe guardrails. This ticket covers interaction design, a small Figma prototype for the Insights Lens, microcopy for risk warnings, and a short playbook for applying recommendations in canary rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype of the Annotator & Tune Lens with three states: (1) baseline insight, (2) suggested profile, (3) apply/preview with rollback hints
Microcopy for each warning/risk label reviewed and signed off by Security and PM
Interactive mock that connects a sample trace to a suggested prefetch/batching preset and shows token-savings and latency delta estimates
Hand-off notes and a small QA checklist for Frontend and Product to implement the lens
A short canary playbook document linked in the ticket and accessible from the Console rollout modal
comments: 2025-02-21 - Ruth Chen: Kickoff — scoped to UI lens + micro-prototype. Exclude backend scheduling changes; assume the runtime exposes a recommendation API (ENG-48291).

2025-02-24 - Aisha Patel: Initial wireframes uploaded to Figma. Focused on three-column layout: signal summary, pattern examples, and recommended profile card. Need PM feedback on how aggressive recommendations can be by default.

2025-02-26 - Miguel Ortega (PM): Prefer conservative defaults; recommendation should default to 'observe' mode and require explicit opt-in to apply. Add an explicit 'safety score' next to each preset.

2025-02-28 - Design review with Eng: We agreed the preview will show simulated 1-hour token-savings and 95th percentile latency impact using synthetic trace. ENG asks to include fallback guidance when KV cache miss rates > 30%.

2025-03-05 - Security review (notes): No PII displayed in the lens; ensure the playbook references KMS policies for private deployments. Minor copy edits requested around 'can degrade quality' phrasing.
2025-03-06 - Aisha Patel: Marking In Progress — engineering handoff scheduled 2025-03-10. Created GH ticket ENG-50122 for API integration and feature flagging.
review_notes: Design critique 2025-02-27: Keep the primary CTA as 'Preview impact' rather than 'Apply' to prevent inadvertent rollouts.
PM comment 2025-02-26: Add explicit explanation for canary steps and who can approve immediate apply in Dedicated vs Hosted plans.
